tools.name: get_client_by_name
tools.description: Search for a client by full or partial name. Returns client_id, segment, AUM, RM, risk profile, preferred language, and last contact date.

tools.name: get_account_summary
tools.description: Get all bank accounts (savings, current, FD) with balances for a client.

tools.name: get_recent_transactions
tools.description: Get significant recent transactions for a client, filtered by number of days and minimum amount in INR.

tools.name: get_kyc_status
tools.description: Get KYC document status and expiry dates for a client. Flags expired or soon-to-expire documents.

tools.name: get_crm_history
tools.description: Get recent CRM interaction history for a client: call notes, email summaries, meeting outcomes.

tools.name: get_rm_client_list
tools.description: Get all clients assigned to an RM, optionally filtered by segment (HNI, MassAffluent, SME).

tools.name: get_credit_bureau_report
tools.description: Fetch CIBIL credit score, active loans, and credit history for a client via AWS Credit Bureau agent.

tools.name: get_account_aggregator_data
tools.description: Fetch cross-bank financial data via RBI Account Aggregator framework: FDs, SIPs, and loans at other banks.
